New York Herald, 23 May 1866, p. 6, col. 1
claims.verbatim:
The Inman steamship City of New York, Captain
Leitch, which left Liverpool at two o'clock on the after-
noon of the 9th and Queenstown on the 10th of May,
arrived at this port yesterday morning.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 23 May 1866, p. 11, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Steamship City of New York, Leitch, Liverpool May 9 via
Queenstown 10th, with mdse and 738 passengers, to John G
Dale. May 9, 3:40 PM, passed steamship City of Washington
bound in; 10th, bark R A Allen, for Liverpool; at 5:50 PM,
steamship Denmark, going into Queenstown; 18th, 6:26 AM,
bark Eagle, bound W; 19th, 4:20 PM, steamship England,
hence for Liverpool.
